g.text: One beach section under two regimes (cross-sections, not to scale)
up the beach by swash: 30 units
up the beach by swash: 15 units
A is constructive: swash moves 30 units up but backwash returns
only 18, a net gain of 12, and the upper profile builds up.
B is destructive: backwash removes 28 units while swash brings
15, a net loss of 13, and the upper beach is lowered.
The bar growing offshore in B is where removed material is
stored; it does not contradict erosion of the upper beach.
